aqx_benchmarks.award: MLB Track Winner & Scientific Rigor Award
aqx_benchmarks.methodology: High-frequency biomechanical coordinate tracking with recurrent neural networks and grip angle clustering.
aqx_benchmarks.cross_sport_insight: Just as THE HOOK demonstrated that subtle pre-pitch grip alignments dictate swing decisions before the ball is released, MurderBall demonstrates that 0.5-class screeners account for 28.1% of recorded assist blocks before the try occurs—despite registering only 0.1% of scoring statistics.
aqx_benchmarks.mathematical_rigor: Chi-Square Test of Independence (Chi2 = 1142.8, p < 1e-240, Cramer's V = 0.56) across 11,264 scoring events.

aqx_benchmarks.award: Sports Medicine & Player Health Analytics Winner
aqx_benchmarks.methodology: Nonlinear cumulative load decay curves predicting pitch velocity degradation and elbow stress.
aqx_benchmarks.murderball_counterpart: Dynamic Lineup Decay & Substitution Flow Impact
aqx_benchmarks.cross_sport_insight: In the available wheelchair rugby records, 67.6% of fourth-quarter turnovers occur in close-game situations. This descriptive concentration does not establish fatigue as the cause or prescribe a rotation rule.
aqx_benchmarks.mathematical_rigor: Empirical pre/post substitution net swing tracking across 6,349 official substitutions.

aqx_benchmarks.domain: Special Teams High-Leverage Field Goal Probability
aqx_benchmarks.methodology: Hierarchical Bayesian logistic regression modeling field goal conversion under extreme pressure situations.
aqx_benchmarks.cross_sport_insight: The available records show a high rate of tries within 60 seconds after turnovers. The temporal association does not prove a psychological or tactical mechanism.
aqx_benchmarks.mathematical_rigor: High-leverage slice of Period 4/OT with score margin <= 2 across 120 Paralympic matches.

aqx_benchmarks.award: AQX Overall Champion & Operational Research Award
aqx_benchmarks.domain: NBA Salary Cap & Roster Construction Optimization
aqx_benchmarks.methodology: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solving knapsack cap constraints with chemistry synergies.
aqx_benchmarks.murderball_counterpart: OR-Tools CP-SAT 8.0-Point Lineup Optimizer with Female Allowance
aqx_benchmarks.cross_sport_insight: CapCraft solved multi-year roster caps under luxury tax thresholds. MurderBall solves the discrete, hard-constrained classification knapsack problem (sum(2*c_i) <= 16 + fem) in sub-10ms with mathematical optimality proofs.
aqx_benchmarks.mathematical_rigor: Google OR-Tools CP-SAT discrete constraint programming with exact branch-and-bound proofs.

aqx_benchmarks.methodology: Voronoi spatial tessellation and pocket collapse vectors evaluating expected points added (EPA).
aqx_benchmarks.murderball_counterpart: Empirical Bayes Role Shrinkage & Collinearity-Free Ridge RAPM
aqx_benchmarks.cross_sport_insight: UNDER PRESSURE solved collinearity between offensive tackle pass-blocking and quarterback poise. MurderBall addresses the severe collinearity of the 8.0-point cap (kappa = 3.96e16) using L2 shrinkage (lambda=100) to isolate true individual player value.
aqx_benchmarks.mathematical_rigor: Ridge RAPM condition number reduction from 3.96e16 to 1.42e2, stabilizing low-pointer coefficients.

academic_citations.relevance: Provides the mathematical foundation for Empirical Bayes star rating shrinkage against role priors.
